content.short: MegaETH is a real-time Ethereum Layer 2 targeting sub 10 millisecond block times and over 100,000 transactions per second.
content.description: MegaETH is an Ethereum Layer 2 built around the claim that blockchains should feel like ordinary web infrastructure. It separates sequencing, execution, and proving across specialised nodes so a single powerful sequencer can push block times under ten milliseconds and sustain well over a hundred thousand transactions per second while still settling to Ethereum. The intent is to make latency sensitive applications viable onchain: order book trading, real-time games, and interactive consumer apps that break down when confirmations take seconds.
